title: Self-harm: understanding and getting help
citation: Leaune, E., & Bui, E. (2025). A (global) mental health crisis? International Journal of Mental Health, 54(4), 414-416.
content:
Self-harm: understanding and getting help.

Self-harm can be a way of coping with overwhelming emotional pain rather than an attempt to seek attention or manipulate others. People may turn to self-harm because it temporarily reduces distress or provides a sense of relief when emotions feel difficult to manage. Understanding the emotional function behind self-harm helps reduce stigma and encourages compassion. With the right psychological support and healthier coping strategies, people can learn other ways to manage intense emotions and recover over time.
